Population increased in Lichfield

The estimated population of Lichfield in 2024 was 111,932 usual residents, a rise of 1.6% since 2023.

This meant that Lichfield's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Lichfield increased by 4.7%.

Over this slightly longer period, Lichfield was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Lichfield

The average (median) age fell to 45.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Lichfield has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Lichfield is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Lichfield's population of 111,932 usual residents was made up of:

  • 18,705 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.7%)
  • 66,340 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.3%)
  • 26,887 people aged 65 years and over, (24%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Lichfield has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (24% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Lichfield, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Lichfield
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Lichfield, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 191 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 959 births and 1,150 deaths in Lichfield.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,745 (1.6%). There were 7,212 people entering the area and 5,467 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Lichfield's population of 188 (0.2%) as a result of 391 people entering the area and 203 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Lichfield was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Lichfield in mid-2023 is 110,192.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 65 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 46 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 19 people.
